pages.text: Thought to be fairy tales, these omens of death are very real and loyal to their summoner.
One can call upon a loyal black wolf through the use of a $(l:focuses/wild/hunting_focus)Hunting Focus$(), or through a ritual which summons one without a limited lifespan.
Right-clicking on a loyal Black Wolf with meat will heal them.
Summoning Black Wolves through certain ways may also yield variants of the beast or even other types of hounds.

An undead version of regular wolves, though unlike them, these wolves may emit a howl that boosts the damage of their skeleton allies. Unlike the other two variants, these wolves don't turn invisible when hunting their query. They are summoned by casting $(l:focuses/wild/hunting_focus)Hunting spell$() with a $(l:crafts/staff/necro_staff)Necro Staff$(), or through another ritual.

These white furred canines are a terror to people living in cold areas, with their icy fangs and resistance to frost. They are summoned by casting $(l:focuses/wild/hunting_focus)Hunting spell$() with a $(l:crafts/staff/frost_staff)Frost Staff$(), summoned in snowing biomes, or through another ritual.

Legends of fiendish hounds that appear in a clap of thunder have been abound, now their lightning jaws are yours to command. They are summoned by casting $(l:focuses/wild/hunting_focus)Hunting spell$() with a $(l:crafts/staff/frost_staff)Storm Staff$(), summoned in an exposed storm, or through another ritual.

You've heard of tales and myths of hounds dragging the damned to the fires of the Nether, perhaps it's time to put these hounds to heel. They are summoned by casting $(l:focuses/wild/hunting_focus)Hunting spell$() with a $(l:crafts/staff/nether_staff)Nether Staff$(), summoned in Nether biomes, or through another ritual.
